svg.text: Schematic rev A | matches cw_decoder.ino | logic 3.3 V, NeoPixel on 5 V
unused: A0 D0 D3 D4 D8 RST RX TX
R1 + C1 protect/filter the key line; R2 softens the piezo; R3 + C2 protect the NeoPixel data/supply; C3/C4 decouple the 3.3 V rail.
OLED pin order GND-VCC-SCL-SDA is the common one but varies between modules: check yours. Pins shown are the ones the sketch uses.
